message: (`<button class="pct-widget__retry" type="button" [attr.aria-label]="retryLabel()">`), and the tag scan never found it
$reason: `tag-swallowed-by-an-expression` with a native `<button>` in place of the `role="button"` span. The false tag `<limit())` swallows a widget's own tag, which the tree holds as it is, and the refusal names the tag the scan never found. A count of widget tags over the text stood before that refusal: it found the button the scan did not and blamed an unbalanced quote. The span the other case swallows is no widget tag and never reached the count.
